attributes.title: Level 5

subgroups.name: solve 1

steps.hints: ❓Did you right click on the [createWatermelon] container and select “Create ‘call createWatermelon’” to create the call function block?
steps.senseiHelp:
Ask the ninja: 

❓ After you define a function, what other block needs to be used in order for the function code to run?

❓ How can you create a function call in a project?


Solution: 

The [call createWatermelon] block should be added to the [on button pressed] container. The ninja can right click on the [createWatermelon] function then select “Create ‘call createWatermelon’” to create the function call block.
steps.instructions:
When you press the A button, nothing appears on the screen! 


Fix the bugs in the code so that the A button uses the [createWatermelon] function to make watermelon sprites appear on the screen.

subgroups.name: solve 2

steps.hints: ❓Where should the [call createStrawberry] block be placed so that strawberries appear on screen when the B button is pressed?
steps.senseiHelp:
Ask the ninja: 

❓ When should strawberries appear on the screen?

❓ Which block causes a function’s code to run?


Solution: 

The [call createStrawberry] block should be moved from the [on start] container into the [on B button pressed] container.
steps.instructions:
When the project runs, only 1 strawberry appears on screen, and nothing happens when the B button is pressed.


Fix the bugs in the code so that strawberries appear on screen only when the B button is pressed.

attributes.description: You’ve reached Level 5 of Orange Belt! Before you create your final Orange Belt project, there are a few neat tricks to learn that could take your game to the next level! In this level, you’ll learn more about functions, which are chunks of code that run whenever they are called. You’ll learn how to create your own functions to simplify code and make something happen multiple times in a project. Here are the achievements you’ll unlock in Level 5:

badges.title: Function Junction
badges.description: Create functions, with and without parameters, to make something happen in a project.

badges.title: Make Your Own Way
badges.description: Create a new function to be used in a project.

badges.title: Don't Forget To Call
